baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural speech verb, the emphatic first-person plural clause, the past-state copula, and the plural active participle make the group both speaker and object of judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Audible speech turns the verdict inward: temporal predication locates limit-crossing in the group's own prior continuing state. The cry of woe therefore does more than register damage; it publicly assigns agency and duration to the speakers themselves.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the public vocal act through which an inward verdict becomes a shared avowal.
Temporal being makes transgression a state they had inhabited, not only a single completed deed.
The image of crossing a proper bound supplies the content of the group's self-indictment.

changed_reading.before: They lament that a disaster has happened to them and call themselves wrongdoers in general.
changed_reading.after: They publicly identify themselves, as a coordinated group, as having lived in a continuing condition of crossing bounds.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The past-state construction and the predicate rooted in t-gh-y permit a material reading of excess alongside the moral reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory activates surging beyond measure. On this reading, their former condition was not merely disobedience counted as an item; it was an expanding force that exceeded its channel and overwhelmed boundaries. The lament marks recognition after that excess has recoiled upon its source.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication gives the surging image duration as the group's former mode of being.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes a physical surge beyond bounds, turning moral excess into a force-and-channel mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Transgressors means people who broke a rule.
changed_reading.after: Their conduct had swollen past measure like a surge that could no longer remain within a sustaining boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier character sequence couples speech that wounds and circulates with a hand that stops benefit, then names boundary-crossing. It activates the focus predicate as a social pipeline: harm is made mobile while good is arrested. The plural confession internalizes that profile rather than leaving it as a portrait of someone else.

activation_trace.role: Fault-finding and attacking people supplies interpersonal harm as one moving part of transgression.
Speech carried out as tale-bearing gives harmful talk a circulation mechanism.
The hand withheld from giving supplies the inverse movement: benefit is deliberately stopped.
Exceeding a bound while wronging others explicitly joins the speech-and-withholding sequence to the focus predicate.
The focus branch gathers the earlier mobile harm and blocked good under the group's own admission of limit-crossing.

structural_cues: The earlier descriptors form a behavioral chain rather than an unordered vice list.
The focus shifts the accusation into emphatic first-person plural speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies injurious speech, circulating disclosure, withheld good, and explicit boundary-crossing. I infer an arrow from those linked behaviors to the group's compressed self-description. A live alternative is that the earlier portrait and the garden group are separate examples with no transferred mechanism.

changed_reading.before: We were arrogant or disobedient in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: We participated in a social order that let harm circulate while deliberately preventing benefit from reaching others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group first sees, then diagnoses itself as lost, corrects that to deprived, admits displaced or withheld right, and turns to mutual blame. The focus statement is the next diagnostic depth: passive location and deprivation give way to a causal account centered on their own sustained excess.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing initiates the diagnostic sequence with an encountered condition that demands explanation.
Loss of the expected object supplies the first, externally oriented explanation of what they see.
Missing the desired thing revises simple mislocation into experienced deprivation.
Putting something outside its proper time or place introduces moral disorder rather than mere loss.
Mutual deserved blame shows responsibility circulating within the group immediately before joint confession.
Past-state predication deepens episodic blame into recognition of a continuing prior condition.
Overstepping the bound supplies the final causal diagnosis and relocates agency in the speakers.

structural_cues: The explicit corrective particle at 68:27 makes at least one diagnostic revision overt.
Repeated plural declarations lead into mutual blame and then the emphatic focus confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible sequence of loss, correction, deprivation, wrongdoing, blame, and focus confession. I infer that the sequence moves from symptom to cause. A live alternative is cumulative lament: the labels may coexist without forming a strict ladder beyond the explicit correction at 68:27.

changed_reading.before: Their property is missing, so they are unfortunate and deprived.
changed_reading.after: They revise the event from something that befell them into evidence of a sustained boundary-crossing condition for which they share agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Harvest, whispered coordination, entry control, the vulnerable outsider, withholding, and effective capacity combine into an access-control operation. The focus predicate becomes relational: their excess was the use of organized ability to enclose a productive space and prevent another person from sharing its yield.

activation_trace.role: Harvesting palm fruit supplies the resource operation around which the group coordinates.
Lowered secret speech makes concealment an enabling instrument of the exclusion plan.
Literal entry supplies the controlled boundary whose crossing the group intends to prevent.
The abasement of poverty identifies the person against whom the access boundary is directed.
Withholding and contraction give the group's purposeful movement its exclusionary force.
Effective power to carry an act through turns desire into organized capacity.
Crossing the proper bound classifies the whole access-control mechanism rather than only one private intention.

structural_cues: The group moves, whispers, states an entry prohibition, and proceeds while describing itself as able.
The focus confession remains plural, matching distributed participation in the plan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harvest, concealed speech, denied entry, a poor person, withholding, and capacity. I infer an arrow from coordinated capacity to exclusion and from exclusion to the focus confession. A live alternative is that h-r-d contributes determined resolve rather than withholding and that the narrative leaves the visitor's exact claim unstated.

changed_reading.before: Their transgression was private greed or a bad intention.
changed_reading.after: Their transgression was an organized use of capacity, secrecy, and boundary control to exclude a vulnerable person from productive benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A surrounding force passes over the garden while images of severed supply, sustenance that stabilizes residence, and stopped milk or rain cluster around the owners' plan. Against the focus root's overflow branch, the story can be read as a reversal of circulation: they try to dam benefit at the human boundary, then an encompassing force leaves their own source cut off.

activation_trace.role: An encompassing flood-like circuit supplies the external movement that overtakes the enclosed garden.
A milk supply cut off contributes a material image of nourishment abruptly ceasing.
Sustenance that lets one remain in place identifies what blocked distribution would ordinarily stabilize.
Cessation of milk or rain reinforces the cutoff side of the circulation mechanism.
Overflowing force lets their moral excess participate in the same material system of surge, channel, and cutoff.

structural_cues: The planned exclusion of benefit is followed by an encircling nocturnal event and total loss of yield.
The cutting root recurs across intended harvest, the garden's resulting condition, and the owners' self-description as harvesters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surrounding motion, severed nourishment, stabilizing sustenance, stopped flow, and overflow. I infer a reversal arrow from their attempted blockage of benefit to the cutoff of their own source. A live alternative is that these are independent lexical images and that no hydraulic or ecological analogy is intended.

changed_reading.before: We exceeded a moral limit and were punished by losing the crop.
changed_reading.after: We became an anti-circulatory excess: by trying to stop benefit at another's boundary, we entered a reversal in which an overwhelming circuit cut off our own supply.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus uses a past state, and the next movement combines hope of return, nurturing repair, substitution, beneficial good, and desire directed toward the Lord. The confession can therefore function as a temporal hinge: it names a former identity precisely when the speakers begin imagining a differently ordered state.

activation_trace.role: Past temporal predication makes the transgressive condition grammatically available as a state that may no longer govern the present.
Hope figured as the return of milk contributes a tentative restoration after cutoff.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supplies an agent and process for reordered growth.
One thing standing in place of another gives the hoped-for future a substitution structure.
Inclination toward beneficial good qualifies replacement by value rather than mere quantity.
Directed desire turns the speakers away from closed self-reliance toward a newly named orientation.

structural_cues: A past-state confession is immediately followed by prospective hope and directional desire.
The first-person plural remains stable while the predicate and orientation change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a past state followed by hope, repair, substitution, beneficial value, and directed desire. I infer that confession marks a possible transition rather than only a terminal verdict. A live alternative is that the hope remains materially self-interested and does not evidence a durable moral change.

changed_reading.before: The confession closes the episode with irreversible self-condemnation.
changed_reading.after: The confession names a former state at the threshold of a hoped-for replacement and redirected desire, without guaranteeing that the transition succeeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later context separates categories and demands the basis for judgment: a ruling, a text that establishes it, a guarantor, and truthful support. In that field, the focus declaration behaves like self-testimony. Their own speech supplies the classification that no external entitlement document or sponsor can displace.

activation_trace.role: Speech as a statement of definition lets the group formulate the operative category for itself.
Offense and wrongdoing supply the classified party on one side of the later contrast.
Judgment between people establishes the forensic register in which classifications require grounds.
Writing that fixes an obligatory ruling supplies the absent documentary basis being challenged.
Bearing surety supplies the challenged guarantor who might answer for a claim.
Truthful speech provides the test against which assertions and the focus confession can be heard.
Limit-crossing becomes the substantive verdict to which the speakers themselves testify.

structural_cues: The emphatic first-person plural clause has the compact form of an admission against interest.
A later run of interrogatives challenges judgment, documentary warrant, guarantee, partnership, and truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies categorical contrast and a sequence of forensic demands. I infer backward that the focus utterance functions as self-testimony within that judgment field. A live alternative is that the later questions address a different audience and need not govern the narrative speech act.

changed_reading.before: The line reports an emotional confession inside a ruined-garden story.
changed_reading.after: The line also functions as testimony against the speakers: their own definition supplies the verdict that later claims of entitlement cannot overturn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the context, speech dismisses signs as false tales, attributes what is not so, lowers itself to coordinate exclusion, and later turns heard remembrance into insult. At the focus, the same speech capacity reverses direction: instead of assigning a false label outward, the group voices a true and damaging predicate about itself.

activation_trace.role: False tales supply an outward dismissive label that contrasts with the later inward admission.
False saying or attribution makes mislabeling by speech an explicit contextual possibility.
Lowered secret speech supplies the concealed middle phase of the group's speech practice.
Making ugly speech or insult heard extends the outward weaponization of language beyond the garden episode.
Audible articulation reverses the speech vector by making the damaging predicate public and self-directed.
Speech as held belief makes the confession a revision in what the speakers now avow, not only a change in volume.

structural_cues: Speech recurs at accusation, secret coordination, confession, and renewed accusation.
The focus predicate is first-person and self-damaging, unlike the outward labels elsewhere.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false labeling, secret speech, insulting speech, and the focus utterance. I infer a reversal from speech used to control others to speech that exposes its own user. A live alternative is that the repeated speech verbs are ordinary narrative framing and do not form a deliberate speech economy.

changed_reading.before: They simply say that they were transgressors.
changed_reading.after: Their speech apparatus turns against its prior habit: a voice used for concealment and outward misclassification now publicly reclassifies the speakers themselves.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping and activates bodily tremor and unstable motion rather than the ordinary speech sense. It remains anchored in the focus speech verb and cry, and a later slipping image gives the kinetic analogy contextual support. Downstream prose should present it only as a sound-and-motion overlay on the utterance, never as a lexical replacement for 'they said.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The initial plural speech verb immediately releases a collective cry of woe, allowing the manner of utterance to matter alongside its proposition.

activation_trace.role: A shuddering tremor makes the confession bodily unsteady rather than calmly declarative.
Rattling unstable motion contributes an acoustic texture of a collective position breaking loose.
Slipping from a station supplies a later spatial analogue for the confession's destabilized voice.

changed_reading.before: The confession is a controlled proposition delivered by a stable collective speaker.
changed_reading.after: The proposition arrives as a vocal shudder: the group's shared position is already rattling and slipping as it names itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 'voice or noise of a people' branch is dialectal, non-dominant, and form-distant from the ordinary predicate. It remains anchored in the focus t-gh-y predicate beside an explicit group speech act, while contextual roots repeatedly stage revealing, lowered, and insulting sound. Downstream prose should qualify it as an acoustic activation: their transgression may include a collective voice that swelled beyond measure, not that the predicate literally means 'noisy.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The predicate of excess occurs inside plural direct speech, so the group's voice can become one medium in which excess manifests.

activation_trace.role: The people's voice or noise makes collective sound itself a possible carrier of excess.
Articulated group speech keeps the acoustic activation attached to a visible focus construction.
A faint sound or movement that reveals its source connects social wrongdoing with involuntary acoustic disclosure.
Deliberately lowered speech gives the group an earlier attempt to control the audibility of its plan.
Audible insult supplies a later instance of sound carrying aggression rather than understanding.

changed_reading.before: Their excess is silent greed later described in speech.
changed_reading.after: Their collective voice may itself have been one site of excess: secretive, injurious, swelling beyond measure, and finally forced into self-disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the smooth high rock branch of t-gh-y and the humbling branch of k-w-n as spatial imagery rather than primary glosses. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is sharpened by the later cluster of prostration, lowered posture, and humiliation. Downstream prose should render it as a vertical metaphor: former self-elevation collapsing into abasement, not as a claim that the focus word denotes a rock.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus contrasts a former t-gh-y state with a present cry of woe, allowing a high-to-low reversal to texture the moral change.

activation_trace.role: A smooth elevated outcrop spatializes the former condition as exposed self-height with insecure footing.
Humbling submission supplies the downward counter-state activated by the confession.
Lowering oneself and abasement establish a later bodily register for vertical moral reversal.
Low posture and submission sharpen the contrast with the activated image of elevation.
Breaking under overpowering force gives the imagined descent its coercive endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They admit an abstract moral fault after material loss.
changed_reading.after: Their cry may stage a vertical collapse: speakers formerly perched in self-elevation are brought into the first language of lowering and submission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a title for a chief whose word has force with the false-authority branch of t-gh-y; neither is the ordinary gloss of the focus forms. It remains doubly anchored in the focus speech and predicate, and the later demand for a group guarantor sustains the authority question. Downstream prose should present it as a political-social model of self-authorization, not as morphology alone proving rulership.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A plural group speaks one emphatic judgment about its own former excess, allowing collective speech and authority to interact.

activation_trace.role: A chief whose word takes effect contributes the model of speech functioning as rule rather than mere description.
False or deviant authority supplies the kind of power their effective group word may have enacted.
Leadership that stands in for a people sharpens the later challenge to unsupported collective authority.

changed_reading.before: They admit that each member privately disobeyed a higher command.
changed_reading.after: They may also admit that their coordinated word had installed itself as an effective authority, deciding access and value without warrant.

strongest_changes: The surrounding confession sequence moves the focus from experienced loss to shared causal agency.
The garden plan specifies t-gh-y as organized exclusion through secrecy, entry control, withholding, and capacity.
Cutoff and overflow branches preserve a material reading in which blocked benefit recoils as loss of the blockers' own source.
The past-state construction plus the next ayah's replacement language leaves confession poised between verdict and possible reorientation.
Repeated speech and later forensic questions let the declaration function both as a reversal of harmful speech and as self-testimony.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line is unusually productive because three compact roots connect speech, temporal identity, and excess. Context does not settle them into one moral paraphrase; it opens social, material, forensic, acoustic, spatial, and reparative mechanisms that can coexist while remaining attached to the plural confession.
remaining_uncertainties: The narrative supports a move from symptom to agency, but not every preceding label must be a discarded diagnosis.
The access-control reading is strong, while the exact status or entitlement of the poor visitor is not stated by the packet.
The ecological circulation model depends on a reader-supplied analogy between branch images of flow, cutoff, and social distribution.
The next ayah's hope may mark genuine reorientation or may remain a wish for material replacement.
The acoustic, trembling, elevated-rock, and authority readings are intentionally retained as form-distant overlays, not lexical substitutions.
